SUPPORT_BOT.SUBTITLE: Ask anything about Devvia, career tips, or technical support.
SUPPORT_BOT.INITIAL_MSG: Hello! I am the Devvia Support assistant. I'm here to help you navigate our ecosystem through the use of tags. What would you like to know?
SUPPORT_BOT.PLACEHOLDER: Select an option or type here...

FLOW.WELCOME: I'm ready to assist you. Choose a topic below or type your specific question in the chat.
FLOW.EXPLORE_PLATFORM: Devvia is a platform designed for junior developers to showcase their talent. You can host projects, get community feedback, and find career opportunities.
FLOW.WHAT_IS_DEVVIA: Devvia is an ecosystem for emerging tech talent. We offer a Project Catalog, a Talent Portal for jobs, and a community space for learning and networking.
FLOW.HOW_IT_WORKS: Start by creating a profile and linking your GitHub projects. Our 'Match' system will then connect you with the best job opportunities based on your skills.
FLOW.BENEFITS: As a Devvia member, you get high-quality visibility for your code, access to exclusive job postings, and a direct path to tech recruiters.
FLOW.CAREER_BOOST: Our Talent Portal focuses on transparency. We show you exactly how well your skills match a job's requirements.
FLOW.FIND_JOBS: Visit the 'Talent Portal' in the main menu. Use filters to find roles that match your technology stack and experience level.
FLOW.MATCH_ALGORITHM: We calculate a 'Match Level' by comparing your project technologies with job requirements. Keep your projects updated to increase your score!
FLOW.INTERVIEW_TIPS: Be ready to walk through your code. Recruiters at Devvia value developers who can explain the 'why' behind their technical decisions.
FLOW.PROJECTS_HELP: Your projects are your most powerful resume. We help you showcase them with stars, forks, and direct repository links.
FLOW.UPLOAD_PROJECT: Go to your Profile and click 'Add Project'. Link your repository and add a clear description to make it stand out in the Catalog.
FLOW.SHOWCASE_TALENT: Great projects have clear READMEs and live demos. Make sure your best work is pinned and well-documented for recruiters to see.
FLOW.OPEN_SOURCE: Devvia supports Open Source. You can mark your repositories as open for collaboration to build projects with other community members.
FLOW.COMMUNITY_RULES: We foster a helpful and professional environment. Connect with mentors in the Forum and join our weekly workshops to grow your network.
FLOW.NETWORKING: Check the 'Events' section for upcoming Hackathons, DevTalks, and Workshops. These are great places to meet mentors and peers.
FLOW.MENTORSHIP: You can find feedback and guidance in the Forum. Many experienced developers in our community are happy to review your code and offer tips.
FLOW.TECHNICAL_ISSUE: If you're having trouble with the site or your account, please select one of the specific options below.
FLOW.SOLVE_SITE: If the site is not loading correctly or you see visual glitches, try clearing your browser cache. If the issue persists, please report the specific error.
FLOW.LOGIN_ERROR_DETAIL: If you cannot login, verify that your email and password are correct. If you forgot your password, you can use the recovery option on the login screen.
FLOW.REPORT_ISSUE: Please report bugs in the 'Support' section of our Forum or email us at support@devvia.com with details about the issue.
FLOW.ACCOUNT_HELP: Manage your security settings, including Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), directly in your User Profile under the Security tab.
